Tokentrim Local Dashboard

The Tokentrim Local Dashboard lets you see and control your Claude Code usage right on your machine. It shows token counts, budgets, and history, and you can trim output and history to keep costs low.

How it works for a single Claude Code session

  1. Install Tokentrim as a plugin or clone the repo.
  2. Run your Claude Code workflow.
  3. The dashboard appears locally and displays the token usage for each step.
  4. Use the trim hooks to reduce history and output before the next call.
  5. The replay command lets you review the exact numbers you saved.

What you get / what it costs / limits

  • Free: all hooks, 3 strength profiles, replay, dashboard, daily budget guard, cold‑cache alert.
  • Pro: $49 lifetime (first 500 buyers) or $9/month.
  • Pro adds a hosted dashboard, Monday digest, weekly budget alert at 80%, Slack totals, and up to 3 machines.
  • Nothing leaves your machine by default.
  • Requires Python 3.9+, tested on macOS and Linux.

FAQ

Question? *How much can I save with the local dashboard?* Answer: On 135 real conversations, trimming history cut re‑read by 75% and extended limits 4.0×, reducing billed cost by roughly 55‑70%.

Question? *Do I need an internet connection?* Answer: No. All data stays on your machine unless you opt for the Pro hosted dashboard.

Question? *What if I want to share the dashboard with a team?* Answer: A shared team dashboard is in development; a paid team audit is available on request.
